{{1927 Midwest Conference football standings}}
The '''1927 Coe Crimson football team''' represented [[Coe College]] as a member of the [[Midwest Conference]] (MWC) during the [[1927 college football season]]. Led by 14th-year head coach [[Moray Eby]], the Kohawks compiled an overall record 4–3–1 with a mark of 3–2 in conference play, placing third in the MWC.<ref>{{cite news |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.--> |title=Cornell Clinches Midwest Conference Title |url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/the-la-crosse-tribune/143226190/ |newspaper=[[La Crosse Tribune|The La Crosse Tribune and Leader-Press]] |location=[[La Crosse, Wisconsin]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 26, 1927 |page=5 |access-date=March 12, 2024 |via=[[Newspapers.com]] {{Open access}} }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.--> |title=Midwest Conference Football Standings 1927 |url=https://static.midwestconference.org/custompages/Past%20MWC%20Seasons/Football/1922-31%20fb%20standings.pdf |publisher=[[Midwest Conference]] |access-date=March 12, 2024 }}</ref> The team played home games at Coe Field in [[Cedar Rapids, Iowa]].
